neighbours.label: a function word in a statement that electrons or matter act as both wave and particle (have both wave and, behave as, also as)
fire: Quantum objects like electrons show both wave and particle behavior.
Light acts as a wave in some experiments and as a particle in others.
An electron has both wave and particle character in the double slit.
Photons behave both as waves and as particles.
Physicists describe the electron as a particle and also as a wave.
De Broglie argued that every particle also behaves as a wave.
Atoms can show wave properties as well as particle properties.
Neutrons diffract as waves yet are detected as particles.
quiet: Quantum objects like electrons carry a negative electric charge in the atom.
Light travels in straight lines in some experiments through thin glass.
An electron has a small mass and sits outside the nucleus.
Photons travel fast and carry energy from the sun.
Physicists measure the electron in a large magnetic field.
De Broglie argued that physics deserved far more funding from France.
Atoms can join together in many ways to form molecules.
Neutrons are found in the nucleus and are detected by counters.
